criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 1, 3, 4 and 9 pass at feed size; 7 is primitive (boom between two plates, flat board, black band under the dek), 8 is type on a mid grey page, 5 reads as a table with the white tape invisible at 432 px, 2's cameras are dark stubs.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; attribution careful; 'every room' leans on the dek; slide 8's dek widens c16's list slightly with the quote beneath it.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear and honest; no deciding body or next step; the consent stake on 9 is left for the reader to infer.

contested: Frame 8 as type on a plate
Whether a retrospective study should cost story points

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Boom links two plates that float apart, the board is flat rectangles, the tile ends in a hard edge into a black band under the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One wall plate and a two piece arm, raised magnetic case cards with casts and a tray, tile extended up behind the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale mid grey page with DOM quotes, relief mostly the clip.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Page about 40 percent of the frame, a curled lower corner casting, only its upper half lit.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The white tape is a grey strip, the 8.3 low end invisible at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A bright raised white stripe three times wider; rake the key lower so lids cast long.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The four cameras read as dark stubs.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lit pale housings at twice the scale with faint view wedges.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The wall camera crowds the dek's third line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop it about 120 px and move it right.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
